name: – Tomas Tobé – § 22 – Am 34
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 22. Considers that the EU cannot credibly denounce the US administration’s targeted sanctions against those responsible for the DSA and other digital legislation, including a former commissioner, while itself imposing restrictive measures on third-country officials because their domestic policies diverge from EU preferences; calls for a consistent rejection of sanctions used to punish lawful legislative or regulatory choices;
